notes.title: Achivment Fix!
notes.notes: We have finally fixed that impossible achievement! And fixed a small typo that had Vivian talking about obscure baseball terminology in the prolouge, but MOSTLY we fixed the impossible achievement "Remind Me Again" so it is now obtainable.

notes.title: The "A La Mode" Update!
notes.notes:
It has been a long road, but here it is. The final version, of the Final Cut.  

This "A La Mode" update contains so much content we need to change the storage requirements of the game! 

Included in (but not limited too) this update you will find:

Over 40 new images.  

70 Achievements.

26 hidden eyes to find (one per chapter)

A brand new image gallery where you can view everything from the game's CG's to the earliest prototypes of Jill and Vivian's 3D models! 

More than 25 new Files to read and collect, containing side stories, new characters, and more of the humor and horror you've come to expect! 

And a sneak peek at what's coming next in the world of Jill O' Lantern!  

But for now, I am very tired, and am going to sleep.  I hope you enjoy the final version of our game. 

Thank you. 


[b]Patch Details:[/b]

[i]
Added Steam and in game achievements.

Added “Extras” section the main menu (unlocks after completing the first chapter of the game)

Added “Hidden Eyes,” to the game. (One per chapter. Finding and clicking on each eye will unlock extra files in the Extras menu). 

Added “Gallery” to the extras menu. (Competing chapters and special requirements unlocks images in the gallery.)

Added Achievements section to the extras menu. (Includes hidden achievements, and hints on where to find each “Hidden Eyes”)

Added Files section to the extras menu. (Files are unlocked by finding and clicking on the Hidden eyes in each level.  The extra files are background and side stories to the main game.)

Added Chapter Select to extras menu. (Unlocks after beating the game.)

Adjusted the menus during the bad ends to better emphasize the “Return to Last Choice” option and disables the load menu to prevent the player from skipping a sequence. 

Fixed the spelling of “Needels”

Added new unlockable Final Scene accessible through the Files Menu by finding all “Hidden Eyes.”
[/i]
